statuses.PENDING: horizon not yet reached — cannot be judged
statuses.SUPPORTED: events inside the stated horizon match the prediction's mechanism
statuses.REFUTED: horizon passed without the predicted event
statuses.UPDATED: predictor restated the claim with a moved horizon or changed mechanism (goalpost-move, tracked explicitly)
statuses.AMBIGUOUS: something resembling the outcome occurred, but not via the predicted mechanism

schema.note: An audit trail is not mockery. Directional risk warnings have value; the ledger's job is to record what was claimed, when, with what horizon, and what actually happened — the accountability the algorithm never provides.

entries.claim: The Fed risks repeating 1937 — tightening into a downturn; economy looks like 1937.
entries.outcome_note: No recession followed; markets went on to record highs.

entries.claim: The 75-year debt supercycle is coming to an end.
entries.outcome_note: No end arrived on any near horizon; framework later restated as the 'Big Debt Cycle' with numbered phases. Vague horizon makes strict refutation impossible — that vagueness is itself an audit finding.

entries.claim: Economy looks like 1937; downturn coming in about two years.
